name: TERI School of Advanced Studies
evidence: The official About TERI SAS page states that TERI School of Advanced Studies was granted “Deemed to be University” status by the University Grants Commission in 1999 and notified by the Government of India.
notes: The supplied https://www.teri.res.in host did not resolve; the current official TERI SAS site is https://www.terisas.ac.in and identifies the same institution in New Delhi.
Normal TLS to the current official host returned the managed proxy certificate-chain error, so curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests.
